key_findings: Spinal HMGB1 rises on day 1 after paclitaxel and acts through TLR4 and RAGE on microglia, with p38 MAPK/NF-kB signalling, to drive allodynia.
TLR4 antagonism lowered spinal TNF-alpha; HMGB1 raised TNF-alpha in cultured microglia.
